description.narrative: El objetivo general de este proyecto es fomentar la competitividad delCommonwealth de las Bahamas reduciendo los costos de realizar trmites con el gobierno. Los objetivosespecficos son los siguientes: (i) agilizar los trmites gubernamentales y ofrecerlos en lnea para reducir el costode la burocracia pblica; (ii) incrementar el uso de las tecnologas de la informacin y las comunicaciones (TIC)en el sector pblico y (iii) imprimir mayor transparencia a las actividades gubernamentales y fortalecer losmecanismos de auditora y control.

The general objective of this project is to foster the competitiveness of the Commonwealth of The Bahamas by reducing the costs of conducting business with the government. The specificobjectives are: (i) streamlining government procedures and making them available online to reduce the cost of government bureaucracy; (ii) increasing the use of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) in thepublic sector; and (iii) increasing transparency of government activities and strengthening auditing and control mechanisms
